item.text: {"text":"{\"status\":\"NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT\",\"core_findings\":[\"Electronics has the weakest fitted separation: 21.89% of positive–negative pairs are misranked, and recent-event deletion produces no mean HR@10 change. Movies and Industrial show stronger fitted separation and larger recent-deletion effects.\",\"CDs has nearly perfect fitted pair separation, while embedding alignment is greatest in CDs and Industrial. These training-only statistics establish neither representation collapse nor held-out recommendation quality.\"],\"key_implications\":[\"Electronics rankings are relatively insensitive to the measured history interventions, whereas Movies rankings depend more strongly on recent events and earlier-event order.\",\"Large differences in fitted margins indicate uneven training separation across datasets; margin magnitudes also depend on logit scale.\",\"Target contamination in the reliance probes prevents interpreting their results as validation gains or causal reliance.\"],\"evidence\":{\"headline_metrics\":{\"Electronics:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":0.2189,\"Electronics:delete_recent_hr10_delta\":0.0,\"Movies_and_TV:delete_recent_hr10_delta\":-0.155,\"CDs_and_Vinyl:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":0.0008},\"brief_metric_read\":{\"Electronics:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":\"Highest fitted pair misranking rate.\",\"Electronics:delete_recent_hr10_delta\":\"95% interval [-0.02, 0.02]; no clear mean effect.\",\"Movies_and_TV:delete_recent_hr10_delta\":\"95% interval [-0.215, -0.10]; fitted ranking worsens.\",\"CDs_and_Vinyl:pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate\":\"Almost all sampled fitted pairs are correctly ordered.\"}}}"}
